name: AbCellera
summary:
AbCellera (ABCL) reported a loss of $0.14 per share on revenue of $8.32 million for the first quarter ended March 2026. The consensus estimate was a loss of $0.22 per share on revenue of $5.71 million. The company beat consensus estimates by 36.36% while revenue grew 96.34% on a year-over-year basis.

AbCellera is a technology company that searches, decodes, and analyzes natural immune systems to find antibodies that its partners can develop into drugs to prevent and treat disease.
subject: AbCellera Beat Consensus Estimates
